seo.webpageTitle: Student of Life: Being a Continuous Learner — The Dev Notebook
seo.metaDescription: Why I call myself a “Student of Life”: a hackathon story about learning by doing, why “I can’t” usually means “I haven’t yet,” and why learning shouldn’t stop when school does.

content.title: Student of Life: Being a Continuous Learner
content.dek: School & college taught us that learning is boring. Here’s why I’m choosing to unlearn that.
